steps.en: Download the desktop installer from the latest release and open it
steps.zh: 从最新 release 下载桌面安装包并打开

steps.en: Detects your agents and lists every installed skill per agent
steps.zh: 识别已装的 agent，按 agent 列出全部已装 skill

steps.en: Search the Discover tab, tick target agents, press Install
steps.zh: 在 Discover 页搜索，勾选目标 agent，按 Install

steps.en: Clones the source repo and copies its skills into ~/.agents/skills
steps.zh: 克隆源仓库，把其中 skill 复制进 ~/.agents/skills

steps.en: Symlinks each skill into every ticked agent's folder and records it in the lock file
steps.zh: 把 skill 符号链接进每个勾选 agent 的目录，并记入锁文件

value.en: One copy per skill, visible across all your agents — no more hand-copying SKILL.md folders into each agent's hidden directory
value.zh: 每个 skill 只有一份，所有 agent 一目了然——不再往每个 agent 的隐藏目录里手动拷 SKILL.md

sources: https://github.com/skillsgate/skillsgate README — Quick Start (download latest release), Features (per-agent management, built-in editor, local-first SQLite)
